name: Matba Rofex S.A.
summary: MATba ROFEX SA operates a framework for futures and options trading. Its agricultural derivatives products include soybeans, wheat, corns, soybean index, chicago soybeans, chicago corns, and basis; financial derivatives products include US dollars and Euros; metal derivatives products include gold; public bonds and merval index; energy derivatives products include oil; shares; and bonds. MATba ROFEX SA was formerly known as ROFEX S.A and changed its name to MATba ROFEX SA in August 2019. MATba ROFEX SA was founded in 1909 and is based in Rosario, Argentina.
